whatIs.title: What is the Government Subsidy Calculator?
whatIs.description: A tool that checks your eligibility for 12+ Korean government subsidy programs at once by entering household income, assets, and member information. Covers Basic Living Security, EITC, Child Tax Credit, Basic Pension, Youth Rent Subsidy, and more.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Enter household size, monthly income, and total assets
Select applicant age and housing type (jeonse/rent/owned)
Check applicable options: children, single parent, disability
Click 'Check Eligibility' to see results for 12+ programs with estimated amounts
Review application methods and official website links for each program

tips.title: Useful Tips
items: Income should be pre-tax (earned + business + property income)
Assets = real estate market value + financial assets + vehicle value
You can receive multiple subsidies simultaneously if eligible
For borderline results, visit your local community center for accurate assessment

items.a: The income level at the exact middle when all households are ranked by income. The 2026 median income for a 4-person household is approximately ₩6.09M.
Yes, since each program has different criteria, you can qualify for multiple programs. However, some programs restrict overlapping benefits.
Real estate (market value) + financial assets (savings, stocks) + vehicle value + other assets. Some debts may be deducted.
